bootstrap.average_effect: reader weight within each literal sentence group mean; normalized sentence weight across literal sentence effects
bootstrap.individual_sentence_effect: reader weights; its shared sentence weight cancels
bootstrap.proper_trial_score: reader weight times normalized sentence weight, then normalize

candidate_gate: NLL difference 95% upper bound <0, human effect 95% CI excludes 0, matching effect direction, 90% model minus human CI strictly inside the equivalence margin
effect_primary: other-language minus German-only after averaging observed and predicted grades in each literal sentence by group, all eligible literal sentences equal weight
intervals: paired percentile 95%, except model minus human equivalence interval 90%
secondary_effect: mean same-sentence sign agreement across the fixed pairs; half credit for a tie
trial_primary: qwen_interaction minus qwen_additive observed grade NLL, nats
trial_secondary: mean squared error of four cumulative ordinal probabilities
